fusions.name: Darting School
fusions.desc: Looses 5 rats at once in a tight fan, each dealing 3 damage.

fusions.name: Slipped Grip
fusions.desc: A slick-furred lunge at one enemy up to 5 tiles away that deals 14 damage, rising to 1.2 times that at full reach, and knocks it 3 tiles back.

fusions.name: Wriggle Free
fusions.desc: Removes up to 3 conditions from you, and your movement speed rises 20% for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Never Quite Held
fusions.desc: Once every 6 seconds, a failed dodge is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
